## Resumo
An editorial, print-inspired comparison data table for 'Table', a product that typesets tables instead of rendering spreadsheets. The whole page is a centered max-w-[1120px] column on a warm cream 'paper' canvas: a sticky translucent nav, a full-bleed serif hero ('The editorial data table.') with a 3-up stat grid, then the centerpiece 'Biggest Gaps' comparison table, an 'Anatomy of a well-set table' 2x2 principle band on a warmer cream, a denser 'Type Specimens' gallery table, a dark 'ink' pricing/CTA band, and a footer. The centerpiece table is a rounded card with a serif column-header row underlined by ONE heavy 2px ink rule, hairline rules between roomy rows, serif row labels, right-aligned tabular-nums delta values (the leaders in burgundy, the rest fading to muted ink), centered circular initial badges (burgundy for AC, ink for MR), and right-aligned significance pills (burgundy-tinted for Major, hairline-bordered for Moderate/Minor). On mobile the 4-column grid reflows: each row becomes a label + right-aligned value on line one, with the badge and pill wrapping to a second line, so nothing is squished or horizontally scrolled. Set in Fraunces (serif) + Inter (sans) on a cream + ink + burgundy palette.

## Estilo Visual
Use a warm editorial paper + ink + burgundy design system. Page background is cream 'paper' #faf6ef; a warmer band surface is #f3ecdf (used for the anatomy section and as the row-hover background). Text is warm near-black 'ink' #1c1815, stepped down to #6b635b (ink-60) and #9a9087 (ink-40) for secondary and faint text. The single accent is burgundy #7b2d3b (with #9c3f4f as the hover / lighter burgundy); use it sparingly only for leading numeric values, key initial badges, the eyebrow rules, 'Major' significance pills (as a #7b2d3b at 10% tint), the primary 'Browse the gallery' CTA and accent CTAs on the dark band. All rules and borders are one sand hairline #e4dccd; the ONLY heavy rule is a 2px solid ink #1c1815 line directly under each table's column-header row. Two typefaces from Google Fonts: Fraunces (serif, weights 300-700, optical-size axis) for the display H1/H2/H3, the big stat numbers and the table row labels/names; Inter (sans, weights 400/500/600/700) for body copy, uppercase tracked labels (letter-spacing 0.22em on nav/eyebrows, ~0.18em/0.16em on table headers) and all UI chrome. Numeric values use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (a .tabnum class) so the +delta values align right. Depth is minimal: two faint burgundy blurred radial blobs behind the hero (bg-burgundy at /5 and /4, blur-3xl), one soft long lift shadow on the centerpiece table card (0 1px 0 rgba(28,24,21,0.02), 0 24px 60px -32px rgba(28,24,21,0.25)), hairline borders elsewhere, and the pricing/CTA section inverts to a dark ink #1c1815 panel with cream #faf6ef text (secondary text at cream/70, accents in the lighter burgundy #9c3f4f). Corners: rounded-xl/2xl on cards and the table, rounded-full on pills, CTAs and circular badges, rounded-[7px] on the small logo tile. Icons are Phosphor (ph:*) via the iconify-icon web component (ph:ruler, ph:arrow-up-right, ph:check). An animated underline-link effect (a background-size 0%->100% 1px line on hover) and a 0.2s row-hover background tint to #f3ecdf are the only motion.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky translucent nav
A sticky top-0 z-50 header on a translucent cream bg-cream/85 with backdrop-blur-md and a bottom border-rule hairline. Inside the centered max-w-[1120px] container, a h-16 flex justify-between nav: left = a logo lockup (a 28x28 rounded-[7px] bg-burgundy tile with a serif cream 'T' + the serif wordmark 'Table'); center (hidden md:flex, gap-9) = four uppercase tracked nav links (Tables / Anatomy / Specimens / Pricing) in Inter text-[11px] font-600 0.22em tracking, ink-60 with an animated underline-link on hover; right = a 'Sign in' text link (hidden on mobile) + a pill primary CTA 'Start designing' (rounded-full bg-ink text-cream px-5 py-2, hover:bg-burgundy).

### Full-bleed editorial hero
A relative overflow-hidden section with a bottom border-rule. Behind it, two pointer-events-none blurred radial blobs (a 96x96 bg-burgundy/[0.05] top-left, an 80x80 bg-burgundy/[0.04] top-right, both blur-3xl). Inside the container, pt-20 pb-16 md:pt-28 md:pb-24: a burgundy uppercase eyebrow with a leading 36px burgundy hairline + text ('The data table, set in type'), a Fraunces H1 at text-[clamp(3rem,8.5vw,6.5rem)] font-500 leading-[0.94] tracking-[-0.02em] reading 'The editorial' / 'data table.' with the second line in italic burgundy, a max-w-[52ch] ink-60 lede, two CTAs (a rounded-full bg-burgundy 'Browse the gallery' + a text link 'See the anatomy' with a ph:ruler icon), and a 3-up stat grid (a rounded-xl border-rule grid-cols-3 with gap-px on a rule-colored bg so the hairlines show through, each cell bg-cream px-5 py-5 with an uppercase ink-40 label over a Fraunces text-3xl number: '240+' with the + in burgundy, '2 fonts', '1 click').

### Centerpiece comparison table ('Biggest Gaps')
The section header is a flex justify-between row: a Fraunces text-[clamp(2rem,4vw,3rem)] H2 ('Biggest Gaps') + an ink-60 subhead on the left, and an uppercase ink-40 tracked label ('Delta Analysis') on the right. The table itself is a rounded-2xl border-rule bg-cream card with the soft lift shadow. Header row: hidden on mobile, md:grid grid-cols-[1.6fr_0.8fr_1fr_1fr] items-center px-7 py-4 with a 2px solid ink bottom border; four uppercase Inter text-[11px] font-600 ink-60 column labels (Criteria left, Gap right-aligned, Advantage centered, Significance right-aligned). Body: a divide-y divide-rule stack of rows. Each row is a row-hover (hover bg #f3ecdf, 0.2s) that is grid-cols-[1fr_auto] below md and md:grid-cols-[1.6fr_0.8fr_1fr_1fr] at md, px-7 py-5 md:py-6: a Fraunces text-[18px]/[19px] row label/name, a right-aligned tabular-nums delta value (top values in font-700 burgundy, mid values in ink, trailing rows fading to font-600 ink-60 then ink-40 and the label itself dimming to ink-60), a centered circular badge (32x32 md / 24x24 mobile, bg-burgundy for 'AC' or bg-ink for 'MR', cream initials), and a right-aligned significance pill. Below the card, a legend row (flex-wrap, text-[12px] ink-60) with three swatches: a burgundy dot 'Chen leads (AC)', an ink dot 'Rivera leads (MR)', and a burgundy-tinted ring dot 'Significance pill'.

### Significance pills
Each row's significance is a rounded-full pill, right-aligned in its column. 'Major' = a burgundy-tinted pill bg-burgundy/10 text-burgundy px-3.5 py-1 text-[12px] font-600 (px-3 py-0.5 text-[11px] on the mobile second line). 'Moderate' and 'Minor' = a quieter ghost pill border border-rule text-ink-60 with the same padding, so the eye is drawn only to the Major (burgundy) pills.

### Anatomy principle band (2x2)
A full-bleed section with border-y border-rule on the warmer cream bg-cream-2/60. Inside the container (py-20 md:py-28): a header row (a Fraunces H2 'Anatomy of a well-set table' + an uppercase ink-40 'Four principles' label), then a 2x2 grid (md:grid-cols-2, gap-px on a rule-colored bg so hairlines show, each cell bg-cream p-8 md:p-10) of four principle cards. Each card has a burgundy uppercase numbered eyebrow ('01 — Headers', '02 — Rhythm', '03 — Rules', '04 — Color'), a Fraunces text-2xl H3 title, and an ink-60 body paragraph explaining the typographic principle (serif headers, generous row spacing, hairline rules only, restrained accent).

### Specimens gallery table (denser)
A second, denser comparison table section (id specimens): a header (Fraunces H2 'Type Specimens' + subhead, and an uppercase ink-40 'Gallery — 12 of 240' label). The table is a rounded-2xl border-rule bg-cream card (no lift shadow this time). Header row: hidden md:grid grid-cols-[2fr_1fr_1fr_0.8fr] with a 2px ink bottom border and four uppercase labels (Specimen / Use case / Density / Status). Rows: divide-y divide-rule, grid-cols-2 below md and md:grid-cols-[2fr_1fr_1fr_0.8fr] at md, px-7 py-5; a Fraunces text-[18px] specimen name, two Inter text-[14px] ink-60 cells (use case, density), and a right-aligned status pill (burgundy-tinted 'Live' / ghost-bordered 'Beta').

### Dark pricing / CTA band
A full-bleed section that inverts to bg-ink #1c1815 text-cream. Inside the container (py-20 md:py-28): a 2-col md grid (items-center gap-12). Left = a lighter-burgundy #9c3f4f uppercase eyebrow ('Start free'), a Fraunces H2 ('Set your next table like an editor.') with 'like an editor.' in italic lighter-burgundy, a cream/70 lede, and two CTAs (a rounded-full bg-cream text-ink 'Open the studio' that flips to bg-burgundy-2 text-cream on hover + a 'View the gallery' text link with a ph:arrow-up-right icon). Right = a rounded-2xl card border-cream/15 bg-cream/[0.04] p-8 holding a Fraunces text-5xl '$0' price + '/ to start', over a 4-item feature list where each li uses a lighter-burgundy ph:check icon (240+ layouts, Fraunces + Inter tuned for tables, one-click export to HTML and React, palette tokens yours to override).

### Footer
A border-t border-rule bg-cream footer: inside the container (py-12), a flex justify-between row (stacks on mobile): the logo lockup again (burgundy 'T' tile + serif 'Table'), a row of uppercase tracked footer links (Gallery / Anatomy / Specimens / Pricing) in Inter text-[11px] ink-60, and a small ink-40 copyright line ('© 2026 Table. Set in Fraunces & Inter.').

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Build the table headers as a hidden md:grid row of uppercase Inter labels (text-[11px] font-600 0.18em tracking, ink-60) underlined by exactly ONE heavy 2px solid ink #1c1815 bottom border (border-b-2 border-ink). Everything else in the table is a sand hairline (#e4dccd) between rows (divide-y divide-rule). This single-heavy-rule + hairlines treatment, with the row labels themselves set in the serif (Fraunces), is the editorial signature: the data and the type do the talking, not chrome.

### Componente
The 'Gap' column is right-aligned tabular-nums numbers (.tabnum / font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) that encode rank by weight + color: the top deltas are font-700 burgundy #7b2d3b, the next are font-700/600 ink #1c1815, and the trailing low-delta rows fade to font-600 ink-60 #6b635b then ink-40 #9a9087 (with their serif row labels also dimming to ink-60). Numbers stay column-aligned because of tabular-nums.

### Componente
The 'Advantage' column centers a circular initial badge: 32x32 (h-8 w-8) on desktop / 24x24 (h-6 w-6) on the mobile wrap line, grid place-items-center rounded-full, cream initials in font-700 text-[11px]/[10px]. The badge color encodes the leader: bg-burgundy #7b2d3b for 'AC' (Chen) and bg-ink #1c1815 for 'MR' (Rivera). A small legend below the card decodes the two badge colors plus the significance-pill swatch.

### Componente
Right-aligned rounded-full significance pills that draw the eye only to the important rows: 'Major' is a burgundy-tinted pill bg-burgundy/10 text-burgundy; 'Moderate' and 'Minor' are quieter ghost pills with a border-rule hairline and ink-60 text. Same pattern reused in the specimens table for status (burgundy-tinted 'Live' vs ghost-bordered 'Beta').

### Componente
Because both tables are CSS grids of direct children (not a <table>), they reflow cleanly below md: the row becomes grid-cols-[1fr_auto] where line one is the serif label + the right-aligned delta value (row-start-1 col-start-2), and a md:hidden block on line two carries the circular badge + the significance pill (col-span-2, gap-y-2). The desktop-only badge/pill cells are hidden md:flex. Result: on a phone every row is a legible label + value with its badge/pill wrapping underneath, no horizontal scroll or squish; at md and up it's the full 4-column matrix.

## Notas Especiais
Two typefaces from Google Fonts: Fraunces (serif, opsz 9..144, weights 300/400/500/600/700) for the display H1/H2/H3, the big stat numbers and the table row labels/names; Inter (sans, weights 400/500/600/700) for body, uppercase tracked labels and UI. Tailwind is loaded via the CDN with a custom theme.extend.colors map and a maxWidth.container of 1120px. Exact palette tokens (from the tailwind config): cream #faf6ef (page), cream-2 #f3ecdf (warm band + row-hover bg), ink #1c1815 (text, dark CTA band, the one heavy header rule, MR badge), ink-60 #6b635b, ink-40 #9a9087, burgundy #7b2d3b (the single accent: leading values, AC badge, Major pills as a /10 tint, eyebrows, primary CTA), burgundy-2 #9c3f4f (the lighter/hover burgundy, used on the dark band's eyebrow/headline/CTA), rule #e4dccd (all hairlines). Helper CSS: .label { letter-spacing: 0.22em }, .tabnum { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-feature-settings: 'tnum' }, an .underline-link (background-size 0%->100% 1px line grow on hover, 0.35s), and .row-hover (background-color transition to #f3ecdf, 0.2s). Icons are Phosphor via the iconify-icon web component (ph:ruler in the hero, ph:arrow-up-right + ph:check on the dark band). The named editorial fixes vs a generic data table: (1) ONE heavy 2px ink rule under the header + sand hairlines between rows and nothing else; (2) serif (Fraunces) row labels + tabular-nums numeric column so names read like a printed page while numbers stay aligned; (3) a restrained single burgundy accent that marks only the leaders / key badges / Major pills, everything else ink on cream; (4) a real mobile reflow (CSS-grid rows, not a <table>) so each row collapses to label + value with the badge/pill wrapping underneath, no horizontal scroll at 390px. Everything shares one centered max-w-[1120px] container at px-6 md:px-10, rendered cleanly with no overflow at 1280/768/390.

Numbers stay column-aligned because of tabular-nums.

The 'Advantage' column centers a circular initial badge: 32x32 (h-8 w-8) on desktop / 24x24 (h-6 w-6) on the mobile wrap line, grid place-items-center rounded-full, cream initials in font-700 text-[11px]/[10px]. The badge color encodes the leader: bg-burgundy #7b2d3b for 'AC' (Chen) and bg-ink #1c1815 for 'MR' (Rivera). A small legend below the card decodes the two badge colors plus the significance-pill swatch.

Right-aligned rounded-full significance pills that draw the eye only to the important rows: 'Major' is a burgundy-tinted pill bg-burgundy/10 text-burgundy; 'Moderate' and 'Minor' are quieter ghost pills with a border-rule hairline and ink-60 text. Same pattern reused in the specimens table for status (burgundy-tinted 'Live' vs ghost-bordered 'Beta').

Because both tables are CSS grids of direct children (not a <table>), they reflow cleanly below md: the row becomes grid-cols-[1fr_auto] where line one is the serif label + the right-aligned delta value (row-start-1 col-start-2), and a md:hidden block on line two carries the circular badge + the significance pill (col-span-2, gap-y-2). The desktop-only badge/pill cells are hidden md:flex. Result: on a phone every row is a legible label + value with its badge/pill wrapping underneath, no horizontal scroll or squish; at md and up it's the full 4-column matrix.

structured.special_notes: Two typefaces from Google Fonts: Fraunces (serif, opsz 9..144, weights 300/400/500/600/700) for the display H1/H2/H3, the big stat numbers and the table row labels/names; Inter (sans, weights 400/500/600/700) for body, uppercase tracked labels and UI. Tailwind is loaded via the CDN with a custom theme.extend.colors map and a maxWidth.container of 1120px. Exact palette tokens (from the tailwind config): cream #faf6ef (page), cream-2 #f3ecdf (warm band + row-hover bg), ink #1c1815 (text, dark CTA band, the one heavy header rule, MR badge), ink-60 #6b635b, ink-40 #9a9087, burgundy #7b2d3b (the single accent: leading values, AC badge, Major pills as a /10 tint, eyebrows, primary CTA), burgundy-2 #9c3f4f (the lighter/hover burgundy, used on the dark band's eyebrow/headline/CTA), rule #e4dccd (all hairlines). Helper CSS: .label { letter-spacing: 0.22em }, .tabnum { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-feature-settings: 'tnum' }, an .underline-link (background-size 0%->100% 1px line grow on hover, 0.35s), and .row-hover (background-color transition to #f3ecdf, 0.2s). Icons are Phosphor via the iconify-icon web component (ph:ruler in the hero, ph:arrow-up-right + ph:check on the dark band). The named editorial fixes vs a generic data table: (1) ONE heavy 2px ink rule under the header + sand hairlines between rows and nothing else; (2) serif (Fraunces) row labels + tabular-nums numeric column so names read like a printed page while numbers stay aligned; (3) a restrained single burgundy accent that marks only the leaders / key badges / Major pills, everything else ink on cream; (4) a real mobile reflow (CSS-grid rows, not a <table>) so each row collapses to label + value with the badge/pill wrapping underneath, no horizontal scroll at 390px. Everything shares one centered max-w-[1120px] container at px-6 md:px-10, rendered cleanly with no overflow at 1280/768/390.
